'''Bygone Effigy''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Bygone Effigy}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Sleep
|Intent = Sleep
|Effect = Does nothing. Asleep.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Wake
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 10 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slashes
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Bygone Effigy starts asleep and follows this sequence:
# {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Sleep}} — does nothing on its first turn.
# {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Wake}} — wakes up and gains 10 {{BD2|Strength}}.
# {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Slashes}} every turn after.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Sleep}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|red|up|Your journey ends here...}}
</i></blockquote>
When using {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Wake}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS|||Shall we begin?}}
</i></blockquote>

== Notes ==
* '''Bygone Effigy''''s {{Int2|Bygone Effigy|Sleep}} phase does not feature an actual {{2|Debuffs|Debuff}} status, unlike {{M2|Lagavulin Matriarch}}'s {{BD2|Asleep}} or {{M2|Slumbering Beetle}}'s {{BD2|Slumber}}.

* Because it gains 10 {{BD2|Strength}} before it begins attacking, the '''Bygone Effigy''''s attack always deals 23(25) damage, although the attack itself technically deals only 13(15).

* {{BD2|Slow}} only increases damage from {{QueryLink2|Cards|type:Attack|Attack}} cards, which means cards that apply effects to deal damage such as {{2|Poison}}, {{2|Doom}}, or {{QueryLink2|Cards|type:Power|Power}} effects like {{C2|Serpent Form}} are unaffected.

* When calculating damage for {{BD2|Slow}}, rounding always reduces damage down to the nearest whole number. For example, a {{C2|Strike (Ironclad)|Strike}} (base 6 damage) will deal: 
** 6 damage at 0–1 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 7 damage at 2–3 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 8 damage at 4 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 9 damage at 5–6 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 10 damage at 7–8 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 11 damage at 9 {{BD2|Slow}}
** 12 damage at 10 {{BD2|Slow}}.

* In the case of {{2|Multiplayer}}, each card played by ''any'' player will increase {{BD2|Slow}} for all players for the turn.

== Useful Cards ==
* Cheap, spammable cards like {{C2|Shiv}} and {{C2|Soul}} can help increase {{BD2|Slow}}.
* Strong attacks like {{C2|Bludgeon}} can make it easier to take down the '''Bygone Effigy''' before it begins attacking.
* Defensive scaling cards like {{C2|Footwork}} or {{C2|Fasten}} can make it possible to block most of the '''Bygone Effigy''''s damage once it begins attacking, as unlike most enemies it does not become any stronger over time (outside of its initial buff on the second turn). 

== Trivia ==
* '''Bygone Effigy''''s appearance and abilities are a reference to the {{M|Giant Head||1}} elite from Slay the Spire 1.
